title: Pull early averages toward the group
hook: Two stated cases: explore the evidence weight in a toy shrinkage estimator.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the evidence weight in a toy shrinkage estimator affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Mean, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the evidence weight in a toy shrinkage estimator in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
